notes.title: The Backworld Update: Upgraded Overworld Depth!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! I've been grinding and The Backworld is looking awesome! I've got a demo that should be coming out sometime this year.[/p][p][/p][p]In terms of new gameplay mechanics I've been upping the number of options and strategies at your disposal while exploring in the overworld. [/p][p][/p][p]Enemies now also are damaged by hazards like traps and projectiles created by enemies or toxic ground/air. So you can hurt enemies or even fully defeat them before a battle starts if you can get them to run into these hazards.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323989/db91e2b50557f3dfa68c2cbc7d99294b14ae7f61.png"][/img][/p][p]I have also upgraded the stealth system, you can now crouch near objects in behind the line of sight of enemies to avoid them. The "stealth upgrade" Sandra grants you now allows you to stealth past enemies even if they should be able to see you, and it's basically a very limited resource that replenishes at checkpoints.[/p][p][/p][p]On the super hardcore modes you're really going to have to use these mechanics well to survive! I'm also probably adding in usable items so you can set down traps or shoot projectiles in the world yourself. [/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323989/7840947f473835f62d933abc2e3611db62e6f11a.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: Enemies now also are damaged by hazards like traps and projectiles created by enemies or toxic ground/air. So you can hurt enemies or even fully defeat them before a battle starts if you can get them to run into these hazards.

I have also upgraded the stealth system, you can now crouch near objects in behind the line of sight of enemies to avoid them. The "stealth upgrade" Sandra grants you now allows you to stealth past enemies even if they should be able to see you, and it's basically a very limited resource that replenishes at checkpoints.
I'm also probably adding in usable items so you can set down traps or shoot projectiles in the world yourself.

notes.title: The Backworld Update: Sanity, Hunger, and Dialogue!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The Backworld has been coming along great! I've been writing an insane amount of dialogue for all the companions, especially their reactions to events. I've also put together a banter system where companions will randomly talk to each other while exploring. I wanna make sure every character feels alive!

I'm also going to be adding a sanity and hunger system for those looking for a more hardcore challenge! 

As your sanity gets lower you'll start seeing hallucinations, and there will be some debuffs like a reduced vision range. But who knows... maybe when you're insane you might find some bonus content?

In terms of hunger, it will effect your stats and how long you can sprint. I'm also adding lots of gross healing/food items that will reduce your sanity if you decide to use them. Ever eaten an eyeball?

If these hardcore features aren't your thing, don't worry. I have separated the survival horror and RPG difficulty elements as their own difficulties. So you can for example choose a really hard difficulty for the RPG battles, but a low difficulty for the survival horror elements if you don't find managing your resources fun. So the hunger and sanity systems can be opted out of if that's your preference. 

That's it for this month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323989/a8709e77a1f7399e9ab7e184838ec566add09864.png[/img]

notes.title: The Backworld Lives!
notes.content:
Hey gamers! Numor here! Just letting everybody know that The Backworld is ALIVE AND WELL! I have been working on the game extremely hard, and things have been going great! There should be regular updates from now on. :)

[b]General Updates[/b]

I have signed with a publisher! The official announcement should be very soon, including some info on localization and porting. 

The game is well on its way, with me having built out the base of the entire map already (which I am now filling in with proper good content). We should be looking at a Q1 2026 release. 

[b]What is this game again?[/b]

For anyone who may have forgotten about this game or is curious about the direction it's going...here is a little summary. 

When I went into this project I wanted to make an exploration-focused horror RPG that takes place in The Backrooms with the mission statement of "you don't feel safe, even outside the turn-based combat screen." That has essentially manifested into me adding extra mechanics related to how you traverse and interact with the world/enemies when compared to other classic turn-based RPGs. 

You can sort of see the game as a combo between Undertale + Fear and Hunger + Yume Nikki.

[u]Here are a few mechanics in the game:[/u]

[list]
[*]You can attack enemies before entering combat and sprint to move faster, but doing so causes enemies to detect you from further away.

[*]Enemies have different behaviors when out of the combat screen. Such as spawning traps/projectiles that deal damage to your party or using their own melee attacks to initiate combat with you, dealing damage immediately after you've transitioned to the combat screen. 

[*]You'll have a dodge-roll which allows you to avoid these hazards.

[*]You'll also unlock metroidvania-like abilities that help you explore the world or survive better. Such as stealth to avoid enemies or a hoverboard that allows you to go over gaps. 

[*]You don't get stronger from fighting enemies, you need to explore to find EXP and items that greatly impact combat. 

[*]The game is non-linear so you'll really need to look around these creepy areas while managing your resources. (but there is a clear goal)
[/list]
That's just a few things going on in the game, I'll be going into more detail over time.

Thanks for checking out this update! More will be coming, especially on my YouTube and other social media where I post videos.

notes.title: New Patch
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes.

Added two portals that lead back to previous areas before the Slime fight. In case you didn't explore much and find items, you can easily backtrack now to find some. Also added a few more items in those previous areas.

Added three portals in the same place that lead to some tiny areas that hint at future enemies / dungeons in the game. They also give you some extra items / exp, just to make sure you are strong enough to beat the Slime. (might have some new bugs in these areas)

You should be able to just load your old save and find them.
